title: Pyspark Session did not reach idle status in time
question: I am running a long jupyter notebook on pyspark AWS. I have encountered a strange behavior so that whenever I stop a running cell and rerun it again I got an error similar to: An error was encountered: Session 111 did not reach idle status in time. Current status is busy, and I need to restart the kernet and rerun from the first cell which is too complicated.
answer:
place the below code at the start of the cell to ensure the previous session is stopped before creating a new one.

try:
    spark.stop()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Spark stop failedd: {e}")

relying on spark-submit is good way than jupiter environment
